data.content_ref: inline:The dependence claim is asserted entirely through the vague metaphor 'raw substrate' and 'distilled episode-level abstraction': SRC_001 never states what 0094852dcac7 actually is, what statements it contains, or which specific episode records in SRC_005 it is distilled from. The refutation condition is thus effectively unfalsifiable in practice: 'no episode structure matching ANY statement extractable from 0094852dcac7' can only fail for a file whose content was supplied by the same operators, making the refutation test circular — a distilled summary of operator-supplied records will trivially match those records. The relation names a dependence but specifies no mechanism, no mapping, and no discriminating condition under which two artifacts from the same pipeline could fail it.
